correctness.rationale: The conditional conflict-graph equivalence is exact for every label and arrival ordering. Four exhaustive colour-wrap cases give formula (1), including n=3 and n=4. The path generating function is derived by first-choice recursion. Expanding at z=1 yields beta-integral coefficients B_j>0 with B_{j+1}<B_j/(j+1), so equations (8)--(9) strictly establish the all-size sign. Beta-integral asymptotics give the two constants. A separate finite-graph subset recurrence matches exact rational density for n=3..10; its limited scope is explicit.

originality.rationale: The 2023 paper supplies the one-shot infinite-line model and benchmark, while classical path recurrences and generic greedy local convergence are prior. Searches of semantic mathematical records, web literature and accessible own claims reveal no statement implying the exact finite ring correction, positive sign for all n, or both factorial constants. Distinct repeated-proposal cycle results do not cover the single-attempt dynamics. The priority verdict is qualified by unindexed literature.

No independent historical-priority verification has been performed.

value.rationale: The finite ring is a canonical periodic-boundary counterpart of a published infinite-line adsorption model. The exact strict excess quantifies a finite-volume effect whose sign and decay rate are invisible from the established limiting coverage. Odd and even rings exhibit different leading factorial scalings, a structural consequence of winding and alternating-colour components rather than a small-case enumeration or mere substitution. The theorem is self-contained and potentially useful as a finite-size benchmark.
